title.narrative: Leveraging Local Capacity to Strengthen Health Service Delivery Project (LLCAP) - Human Resources for Health (HRH2)

description.narrative: (Malawi): USAID's Leveraging Local Capacity to Strengthen Health Service Delivery Project-Human Resources for Health (HRH#2) is an integrated activity designed to provide scholarships to improve the availability of well-trained, highly-skilled, and equitably distributed healthcare workforce. The activity will support the delivery of quality health services and will advance the Government of Malawi's National Health Sector Strategic Plan for universal health coverage...Implemented by the Malawi College of Health Sciences (MCHS), the activity will: 1) increase the number and availability of trained and qualified frontline health workers in priority health areas, 2) improve the quality of pre-service education, and 3) increase access to educational opportunities for health workers. To achieve the stated objectives, the activity will specifically train nurse midwife technicians; community midwife assistants; pharmacy assistants; nurses and midwives; assistant environmental health officers; and medical assistants. Additionally, the activity will improve the quality of pre-service education using a training model that equips students with preventive, clinical, nursing, and management of health services. The activity also will support higher education entities to develop a curriculum that promotes a multisectoral approach to respond to health needs during and after climate related emergencies. MCHS is a local organization owned and run by the Government of Malawi. Through this activity, USAID enhances local institutional capacity that will ensure program continuity after the activity closes out. ..The activity enhances Malawi's pathway to locally led development and aligns with the Integrated Country Strategy Mission Objective 3.2 - Malawi improves access to and quality of health services so that more of its citizens gain and retain full health and can contribute productively at home, in the community, and at work..
